subject.title: fix(googlechat): fall back to text link when remote media upload fails with 403

question: Should maintainers repair this member-authored PR as the canonical Google Chat media-upload fallback, or choose a sibling candidate instead?
rationale: The bug is valid, but the branch is conflicting and overlaps with multiple open fixes; the final path affects message-delivery and security-boundary behavior, so automation should not pick the canonical PR alone.

options.title: Repair This PR As Canonical
options.body: Refresh this branch, narrow the helper to insufficient-scope upload failures, preserve send metadata, and use it as the canonical fix for the linked issue.

options.title: Choose A Sibling PR
options.body: Pause or close this PR only after maintainers select another open implementation that is refreshed, proof-accepted, and covers the same three runtime paths.

options.title: Accept Broad 403 Fallback
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept link fallback for every upload 403, but that owns the policy/security risk of converting unrelated denials into raw URL delivery.

recommendation.title: Repair This PR As Canonical
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch, narrow the helper to insufficient-scope upload failures, preserve send metadata, and use it as the canonical fix for the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent routing signal from Google Chat API/action history and prior review context on this fallback cluster.
